items.title: AI-first banks in small-business lending: Live Oak, Huntington and Casca
items.summary: What Live Oak, Huntington and other US banks have publicly launched to put AI into small-business and SBA lending, and what they report. The Huntington–Casca link is confirmed but unexplained in public, Live Oak's Casca rollout is still a pilot, and no bank has yet published a measured result.

items.title: Lumos and alternative credit scoring for small business
items.summary: What Lumos (Lumos Data) is, how its expected-loss score is built and what it does not disclose, set against bureau scores, cash-flow scoring and FICO SBSS, which the SBA stopped using for 7(a) Small Loans in March 2026. Independent studies show real but modest gains from alternative data, concentrated in thin-file borrowers.

items.title: OCR spreading tools vs LLMs for financial statement extraction
items.summary: Compares dedicated auto-spreading tools with general LLM extraction on accuracy, failure modes, auditability, cost and validation, using public benchmarks, vendor materials and US guidance. The best LLMs now read financial pages as well as good OCR, but their errors are silent, so the controls around the extractor matter more than the engine.
